m: कार्षापणावर mfn. having the value of at least one Kārṣāpaṇa (as a fine), Mn. viii, 274 and x, 120.

s: puM klI, (karzasyAyaM “tasyedam” । 4 । 3 । 120 । ityaR । nityaM paRaH parimARe ityap gocarasaYcareti Go vA kArzasya kArzeRa vA ApaRaH vyavahAro yatra । yadvA karzasyedaM svArTe vA aR tena ApaRyate । A + paRa karmmaRi GaH .) kArzikaH । zoqaSapaRaH । iti medinI ॥ rUpyakarzakftavyavahAradravyam । loke tu tanmUlye zoqaSapaRasamudAye kArzApaRasyopacAreRa pravfttiH । taTA hi SAstrIyo rajatamAzo dvikfzRalaH । dve kfzRale samaDfte vijYeyo rUpyamAzakaH । iti manuH ॥ Adye kftayuge rajatakfzRalayorddaSagaRqA mUlyamiti dvAtriMSatA kfzRalABI rajatakarzasya zoqaSapaRA eva mUlyam । purARaSabdaScAtra kArzikaM purARaYca kArzApaRa iti vopAlitaH । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 8 । 136 । “kArzApaRastu vijYeyastAmrikaH kArzikaH paRaH” ॥)
v: kArzApaRa

puMna॰ karzasyedam svArzevA aR । tena ApaRyate A + paRa--karmmaRi Ga । 1 aSItirattike tAmrike karze “kArzApaRastu vijYeyaH kArzikastAmrikaH paRaH” manuH । 2 zoqaSapaRAtmake purARe (kAhana) iti KyAte mAnaBede । “mAzaH zoqaSaBAgastu jYeyaH kArzApaRasya tu । kAkinI (vuqi) tu caturBAgo mAzasya parikArttitA । paYcanadyAH pradeSe tu saMjYeyaM vyArahArikI । kArzApanapramARantu tannibadDam (pariBAzitam) iheva tat” kAtyA॰ smf॰ zoqaSetyatra hemAdrO viMSatIti pAWaH । ataeva “dvAtriMSatpaRikAgAvo vatsaH pOrARikoBavet” kAtyA॰ smftO purARadvayavAcyadvAtriMSatpaRAnAM gomUtyatvenABiDAnam । “aSItiBirvarAwakEH paRa ityaBiDIyate । te zoqaSaH purARaM syAt rajataM saptaBistu tEH” Bavizyapu॰ । “kArzApaREkamUlyA hi daridrARAM prakIrttitA” prA॰ ta॰ । “kArzApaRaM BaveddaRqyo yatnAnyaH prAkftojanaH । tatra rAjA BaveddaRqyaH sahasramiti DAraRA” “samutsfjedrAjamArge yastvamameDyamanApadi । sa dvO kArzApaRO dadyAt” manuH । “kArzAkpaRo dakziRasyAM diSi rOpyaH pravarttate । paRonibadDaH pUrvvasyAM zoqaSEva paRAH palam । iti nAradokte 3 dakziRadeSaprasidDe pUrvvadeSaprasidDapaRa parimARe ca । kArzApaRena krItaH wiWan vA pratirAdeSaSca iduccAraRArTaH kArzApaRika pakze pratika tatkrIte tri॰ striyAMNIp । kArzApaRikI pratikI aDyardDapUrvAt dvigoSca tasya vA luk । aDyardDakArzApaRa aDyardDakArzApaRikaM sArdDakArzApaRakrIte evaM dvikArzApaRa dvikArzApaRikaM kArzApaRadvayakrIte tri॰ । parSvAdipAWAt svArTe'R । kArzApaRa kArzApaRasaMGajIvizu tri॰ ba॰ va॰ ।
m: कार्षापण m. n. (g. अर्धर्चादि; cf. कर्ष्) ‘weighing a Karṣa’, a coin or weight of different values (if of gold, = 16 Māṣas See कर्ष; if of silver, = 16 Paṇas or 1280 Kowries, commonly termed a Kahān; if of copper, = 80 Raktikās or about 176 grains; but accord. to some = only 1 Paṇa of Kowries or 80 Kowries), Mn. viii, 136; 336; ix, 282
(ifc.) worth so many Kārṣāpaṇas, Pāṇ. v, 1, 29
कार्षापण n. money, gold and silver, L.
कार्षापण m. pl. N. of a warrior-tribe g. पर्श्व्-आदि
कार्षापण m. the chief of this tribe, ib. and iv, 1, 177, Vārtt. 2.
a: कार्षापणः, --णं — (or --पणकः) A coin or weight of different values; Ms. 8. 136, 336; 9. 282. (= कर्ष). --णं Money.

k.v: कार्षापणः कार्षिकः स्यात् कार्षिके ताम्रिके पणः। अस्त्रियामाढकद्रोणौ खारी वाहो निकुञ्चकः॥

m: कार्षापणक m. n. a weight or measure = कार्षापण, L.
कार्षापणिक mf(ई)n. worth one Kārṣāpaṇa, bought &c. with one Kārṣāpaṇa, Pāṇ. v, 1, 25, Vārtt. 2
ifc. id., v, 1, 29.
a: कार्षापणिक — a. (की f.) Worth one कार्षापण.

m: कार्षी f. See गोमय-क्˚.
कार्षीवण m. (fr. कार्षि with इ lengthened), one who ploughs a field, husbandman, AV. vi, 116, 1.
कार्ष्णाजिन mfn. (fr. कृष्णाजिन), made from the skin of the black antelope, ĀpŚr. xv, 5.

v: kArzRAjini
pu॰ kfzRAjinasyarzerapatyam iY । kfzRAjinarze rapatye “kulamatrimiti kArzRAjiniH” kAtyA॰ SrO॰1, 623
m: कार्ष्णाजिनि m. (Pāṇ. ii, 4, 68, Kāś.) ‘a son or descendant of Kṛṣṇājina’, N. of a teacher, KātyŚr. i, 6, 23
of a philosopher, Jaim.; Bādar.
of an author on law.

v: kArzRAyana
pu॰ kfzRasya vyAsasya gotrApatyam naqA॰ brAhmaRe vAsizWe ca viSezye Pak । kfzRasya vyAsasya gotrApatye 1 brAhmaRe 2 vAsizWe ca ।
m: कार्ष्णायन m. a descendant of Kṛṣṇa g. 1. नडादि.

v: kArzRAyasa
na॰ kfzRasyAyasovikAraH aR । kfzRAyasasya vikAre “kArzRAyasamalaNkAraH parivrajyA ca nityaSaH” manuH । striyAM NIp । “aBriM kAzRAyasIM dadyAt” manuH ।
m: कार्ष्णायस mf(ई)n. (fr. कृष्णायस्), made of black iron, ChUp. vi, 1, 6; Mn. xi, 133; MBh. &c.
कार्ष्णायस n. iron, Mn. x, 52; R. i, 38, 20.
a: कार्ष्णायस — a. (सी f.) [कृष्णायस-अण्] Made of black iron; U. 3. 43. --सं Iron.

s: strI, (kArzRa + NIp .) SatAvarI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (SatAvarISabde'syA vivaraRaM jYAtavyam ॥)
m: कार्ष्णी f. the plant Asparagus racemosus, L.

v: kArzRa

tri॰ kfzRasyedam aR । 1 kfzRamfgasanDini । “kArzRarOravavAstAni carmmARi brahmacAriRaH” manuH । 2 kfzRadvEpAyanasambanDini ca “kArzRaM vedamimaM vidvAn SrAvayitvArTama Snute” BA॰ A॰ pa॰ 1 a॰ । kfzRodevatAsya aR । 3 kfzRAKyavizRu devatAke havirAdO tri॰ । “kArzReRa patriRA SatruH sa BinnahfdayaH patan” raGuH । 4 SatAvaryyAM strA rAjani॰
m: कार्ष्ण mf(ई)n. (fr. कृष्ण), coming from or belonging to the black antelope, made of the skin of the black antelope, TS. v, 4, 4, 4; Lāṭy.; Mn. ii, 41
belonging to the dark half of a month
belonging to the god Kṛṣṇa or to Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana or composed by him &c. (e.g. कार्ष्णवेद i.e. the Mahā-bhārata, MBh. i, 261 & 2300), Ragh. xv, 24
belonging to a descendant of Kṛṣṇa g. कण्वादि
कार्ष्ण n. the skin of the black antelope, AV. xi, 5, 6
N. of two Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
a: कार्ष्ण — a. (र्ष्णी f.) [कृष्ण अण्] 1 Belonging to Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu; R. 15. 24. --2 Belonging to Vyāsa. --3 Belonging to the black antelope; Ms. 2. 41. --4 Black. --र्ष्णं Ved. The skin of the black antelope.

m: कार्ष्णकर्ण mfn. fr. कृष्ण-क्˚, g. सुवास्त्व्-आदि.
कार्ष्णसुन्दरि m. pl. the descendants of Kṛṣṇa-sundara, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 68, Kāś.

s: puM, (kfzRasyApatyam । ata iY .) kAmadevaH । iti trikARqaSeSaH । (yaTA harivaMSe । 163 । 19 । “tAmApatantIM mAyAntu kArzRiH kamalalocanaH” ॥ ganDarvvaviSezaH । yaTA mahABArate । 1 । 123 । 53 । “yugapastfRapaH kArzRirnandiScitraraTastaTA” ॥)
v: kArzRi

puMstrI kfzRasyApatyaM bAhvA॰ iY । kfzRasya vyAsasyApatye Sukadeve । “yugapastfRapaH kArzRinandiScitraraTastaTA” BA॰ A॰ 122 a॰ fzikIrttane । 3 rOkmiReye kAmadeve ca । “sA ca taM vardDayAmAsa kArzRiM kamalalocanam” hari॰ 163 a॰ । asyotpattikaTA kAmaSabde uktA ।
m: कार्ष्णि m. (g. बाह्व्-आदि, Gaṇar. 34 Comm.) a son or descendant of Kṛṣṇa, MBh.; BhP.
N. of Viśvaka
of a Deva-gandharva, MBh.; Hariv.
of the god of love, L. (cf. Hariv. 9209.)
a: कार्ष्णिः — [कृष्णस्यापत्यं --इञ्] An epithet of the god of love; Śi. 19. 10.

v: kArzRya

na॰ kfzRasya BAvaH dfQAdi॰ zyaY vA । 1 kfzRatve kfzRasya gotrApatyam gargA॰ yaY । brAhmaRavAsizWannekfzRasya vyAmasya gotrApatye puMstrI striyAM NIp tasya CAtraH kaRvA॰ aR । kArzRa kfzRagotrAptyacCAtre striyAM NIp ।
m: कार्ष्ण्य m. a son or descendant of Kṛṣṇa g. गर्गादि
कार्ष्ण्य n. (g. दृढादि; ifc. f(आ). ) blackness, black colour, darkness, MBh. i, 4236; Suśr.; Rājat.
कार्ष्ण्य n. iron filings, L.

v: kArza
tri॰ kfziH SIlamasya CatrA॰ RaH । kfziSIle kfzItale BarataH ।
m: कार्ष m. (√ कृष्; g. छत्त्रादि), ‘one who ploughs’, a peasant, husbandman, Divyāv.

s: puM, (karzati iti । kfza + “kfzervfdDiScodIcAM” । uRAM । 2 । 38 । iti kvun । yadvA kfziH SIlamasya CatrAditvAt RaH svArTe kan .) karzakaH । ityamarawIkAyAM rAyamukuwaH ॥
m: कार्षक m. id., Kathās.; Rājat. v, 169.

v: kArzi

tri॰ karzatIti karmaH tataH svArTe bA॰ iY । 1 karzaRaSIle 2 antargatamalApanetari । “kArzirasi samudrasya tvA kzityA unnayABi” yaju॰6, 28 । karbatItyebaMSIlaH kArziH antargataSamalApanetAsi” vedadI॰ “kArzirasItyAha SamalamevAsAyapaplAvayati” tEtti॰ ।
m: कार्षि mfn. (cf. कर्षि) drawing, ploughing, VS. vi, 28 [v.l. कार्षिन्, MaitrS.; Kāṭh.]
कार्षि m. fire Comm. on Uṇ. iv, 128
कार्षि f. drawing, ploughing, cultivation, W.
a: कार्षि — a. Ved. 1 Attracting, drawing. --2 Ploughing. --र्षिः Fire. --f. 1 Drawing. --2 Cultivation.

s: puM, (karza + svArTe Wak .) kArzApaRaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 88 ॥ (yaTA yAjYavalkyaH । 1 । 365 । “nizkaH SuvarRAScatvAraH kArzikastAmrikaH paRaH” ॥ karzaH karzaRaM SIlamasya । karza + Wak .) kfzakaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (karzasyAyam । karza + WaY । SAstrIyapalacaturBAgaH । karzaH parimARamasya Wak । karzaparimitadravyam । karzeRa krItaH । WaY । karzakrItaH ॥)
v: kArzika

tri॰ karzaM nityamarhati CedA॰ WaY । 1 nityakarzaRa rha karzeRa krItaH WaY । 1 karzeRa krIte । tatparimARamasya Wak । 3 karzaparimARayukte । karzaH karzaRaM SIlamasya Wak । 4 kfzake hemaca॰ । svArTe Wak । 5 karzaparimARe । “tAmrikaH kArzikaH paRaH” manuH ।
m: कार्षिक mfn. (g. छेदादि) weighing a Karṣa, Mn. viii, 136; Yājñ. i, 364; Suśr.
कार्षिक m. a coin (= कार्षापण), L.
= कार्षक cf. तिल-क्˚.

k.v: कार्षापणः कार्षिकः स्यात् कार्षिके ताम्रिके पणः। अस्त्रियामाढकद्रोणौ खारी वाहो निकुञ्चकः॥

m: कार्षिन् mfn. See कार्षि.

v: kArzman

na॰ karzatyatra kfza--svArTeRic--ADAre manina । 1 yudDe tatra hItaretaraM yoDAH karzantIti tasya taTAtvam । “kArzman vAjI nyakramIt” f॰9 । 36 । 1 “kArzman kArzma yudDam” BA॰ । tataH BAve manin । 2 karzaRe ca ।
m: कार्ष्मन् n. the goal of a race-course (a line like a furrow), RV. i, 116, 17; ix, 36, 1 and 74, 8.
कार्ष्मन् See कार्ष.
a: कार्ष्मन् — Ved. The goal of a racecourse.

v: kArzmarI

strI kfza--Ric--manin kArzma karzaRaM rAti dadAti rA--ka gOrA॰ NIz । SrIparRIvfkze tasyAH vikAraH yat । kArzmaryya SrIparRIvfkzAvayave । “pAlASavEkaNgatakArzmaryya vElvAn” kAtyA॰ SrO॰ 2, 8, 1 । karkaBAzye kArSmaryyeti pAWasyApi dfzwatvAt tAlavyamaDyo'pi tatrArTe ।

m: कार्ष्मर्य m. (= काश्म्˚) the tree Gmelina arborea, TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
कार्ष्मर्य—मय mf(ई)n. made of that tree, ib.
कार्षुक mfn. = ˚षक, Gal.

v: kArzwya
na॰ kfzwasya BAvaH dfQA॰ zyaY । kfzwatvepakze imaBic kfzwiman tatrArTe pu॰ । zittvAt striyAM NIzyalopO ।

s: puM, (kfz + “igupaDeti” 3 । 1 । 145 । kaH । caturvarRAditvAt svArTe zyaR .) sAlavfkzaH ॥ ityamaraH । 2 । 4 । 44 ॥ (asya paryyAyo yaTA । “SAlastu sarjjakArzyASvakarRikASasyasambaraH” । iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥)
v: kArzya
pu॰ kfzyate'sO kfza--GaY svArTe zyaY । SAlavfkze amaraH ।

the tree Artocarpus Lacucha, L.
